company_name: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology, Nano-Processing Facility
semiconductor_relevance: High — the facility provides essential microfabrication and analytical evaluation equipment for semiconductor prototyping and analysis.
summary: The National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology's Nano-Processing Facility offers users access to microfabrication and analytical equipment for creating prototypes and conducting measurements. They provide training for first-time users and technical assistance for advanced operations, making it a valuable resource for semiconductor development.
